posts.title: Boiling the Ocean 12, 13 and 14
posts.description: “Boiling the Ocean” is a sprint/hack days event series from GNOME with varying subjects, which I and a few others from KDE have been joining recently to discuss and collaborate on overlapping topics.

posts.title: OSM Hack Weekend October 2026
posts.description: Last weekend I joined the OSM Hack Weekend at Wikimedia Deutschland’s office in Berlin, mainly to work on a few Transitous-related topics.

posts.title: Open Transport Community Conference 2026
posts.description: I spent last week in Bern, Switzerland, for the second edition of the Open Transport Community Conference, attending that but also being part of the organizer team.
